text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock D at a profit felt rewarding, but I should sell only when my investment plan or view of a stock’s prospects calls for it—not simply to lock in a gain.","Because losses hurt and admitting a mistake is difficult for me, I should assess each holding objectively and not keep it solely to avoid realizing a loss.","My account has moved up and down while I mostly stayed put; I should keep trading infrequently when my reasons for holding remain sound, rather than react to routine monthly swings."]}
